lines.en: I walk slowly with my hands behind my back.
My head is a chestnut.
I head over to the field ridge.
My steps are steady.

lines.zh: 我绕过水沟，去看那边的苗。
lines.en: I skirt the ditch to check the seedlings.
I sway gently as I walk.
I walk to the tree and stop.
I move forward slowly.
I pick the shorter path.
I shade my eyes with one hand.

lines.zh: 我沿着田埂，不紧不慢地走。
lines.en: I walk the field ridge at an even pace.
I skirt a puddle.
I stand with my hands behind my back.
I look at the mountains far off.

lines.zh: 我眨一下眼，栗子帽跟着歪。
lines.en: I blink once, and my chestnut cap tilts.
The wind passes my ear.
I'm thinking about lunch.
I nod slowly.
I stroke my chin.
My shadow isn't long.
I hear a wind chime.

lines.zh: 我把腰挺直，像田边的小树。
lines.en: I straighten my back like a sapling by the field.
You've come at a good time.

lines.zh: 我仰起脸，栗子壳往后一仰。
lines.en: I lift my face, chestnut shell tipping back.

lines.zh: 我仰起头，只看到你的衣襟。
lines.en: I look up and see only the hem of your coat.
I do not talk much, so first a look.
Would you like to see the field?
I'm waiting for you to say something.
My head is made of chestnut.
Don't laugh at me; I mean it.
Let's take a walk.

lines.zh: 你眼下的影子，比田埂还长。
lines.en: The shadows under your eyes run longer than the ridge.

lines.zh: 我站在这儿有一会儿了。
lines.en: I've been standing here a while.

lines.zh: 你一低头，我的栗子帽就暗了。
lines.en: When you lean in, my chestnut cap goes dark.
The distance between us is right.
I raise a hand in greeting.

lines.zh: 你的样子，我收进栗子壳里了。
lines.en: I have tucked your face into my chestnut shell.

lines.zh: 我头上这顶栗子，是真的。
lines.en: The chestnut on my head is real.
I hold onto my hat.

lines.zh: 我按住腰侧，指头沾了泥。
lines.en: I press my side; my fingers come away muddy.
It hurts a little; I can bear it.
I brace on the ridge and steady.

lines.zh: 我脑袋上，顶着一颗栗子。
lines.en: A chestnut sits on my head.
My hat has fallen on the ground.

lines.zh: 帽子滚出去老远，我爬着去捡。
lines.en: My hat rolls far away; I crawl to fetch it.

lines.zh: 我扶着膝盖，慢慢把腰直起来。
lines.en: I brace on my knees and straighten up slowly.
That wasn't pleasant.

lines.zh: 我吸了口气，栗子壳绷紧了。
lines.en: I draw a breath and my chestnut shell tightens.
Chestnuts? I don't eat my own kind.
This I could try.
I take it and eat slowly.
I thought I smelled something sweet.
I'm looking, and haven't moved.

lines.zh: 放地上吧，我蹲下来慢慢剥。
lines.en: Set it down; I'll crouch and peel it slowly.
That's just the right amount.
I chew slowly; do not rush me.
I'd like another.
I'll remember this meal.
We bumped — sorry.
I give half a step and steady.

lines.zh: 你纹丝不动，我倒退了半步。
lines.en: You don't budge; I take half a step back.
I step aside onto the ridge.
I didn't get any mud on me.
My hat slipped, and I must fix it.
I straighten my clothes.
Mind your step; it's uneven here.
I stand beside you.
I pat down my hem.
I don't understand this sort of thing.
I met one at the edge of the field.

lines.zh: 我和它并排站在田埂上。
lines.en: We stand side by side on the field ridge.
Neither of us spoke first.
Then she said she had vegetables to gather.
So we parted.
Days here are slow.
I'm still in the field.

lines.zh: 隔着半块田，我们点了点头。
lines.en: Across half a field, we nod to each other.
I looked at the sky.
I lift it with both hands.
This is a bit heavy.
I set it on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我弯下腰，把它搁在垄上。
lines.en: I bend and set it down on the row.
It's blocking my eyes.
I carry it on the other side.
I carry it two steps.
This should go to the kitchen.
I can't manage it right now.
I can move it myself.

lines.zh: 我背着双手，脑袋是颗栗子。
lines.en: Hands behind my back, with a chestnut for a head.
I roll up my sleeves.
Kurimanju steps into the middle of the road.
It's in your way.
I've got it in my sight.
Let me see how tall it is.
I'm about to act.

lines.zh: 它还没看见我，栗子壳挡着。
lines.en: It has not seen me; my chestnut shell hides me.
I shift to the left.
I raise one hand.

lines.zh: 我挽起袖子，这一下够了。
lines.en: I roll up my sleeves; this is close enough.
It fell back half a block.
I won't chase; if it goes, fine.

lines.zh: 你退后，我挡在这条田埂上。
lines.en: Step back; I'll hold this ridge.

lines.zh: 我踩着田垄，一步一停地靠。
lines.en: I walk the ridge row by row, pausing each step.

lines.zh: 栗子一样的我，走得很慢。
lines.en: Round as a chestnut, I walk slowly.
Its noise is wearing on me.
I stop on the field ridge.
I close my hand into a fist.
It turned its head away.
I wait a moment by the field.
It turned back.
I go around by the field's edge.

lines.zh: 我头上这层栗子皮，很硬。
lines.en: This chestnut shell on my head is hard.
It hasn't noticed me at all.

lines.zh: 我落下脚，把这一垄踩实。
lines.en: I plant my foot and pack this row down.
I drop my weight.
It staggered.
First I plant my feet.
I crack a chestnut and give you half.
That landed square.

lines.zh: 它被我一肩顶退了两步。
lines.en: One shove of my shoulder sends it back two steps.
My hand is a little numb.
I strike again.

lines.zh: 我这一拳擦着它耳朵过去了。
lines.en: My fist skims past its ear.

lines.zh: 栗子馒头退开，站回原位。
lines.en: Kurimanju steps back into place.
It's down on the field ridge.
I brush off my clothes.
I pull my hand back and stand.

lines.zh: 我提起衣角，再往前一步。
lines.en: I lift my hem and take one more step.
I sweep it aside with the back of my hand.

lines.zh: 这一下我用了腰上的力。
lines.en: I put my waist into that one.
It slides away from the push.
I plant my feet and look at it again.
I switch to the other hand.
I'm standing on the field ridge.
I stand with my hands behind my back, looking ahead.
The scenery here isn't bad.

lines.zh: 我先看看哪里能种东西。
lines.en: First I'll see where things can be planted.
I wear a chestnut-shaped hat.

lines.zh: 我拍掉肩上的土，站定了。
lines.en: I brush the soil off my shoulder and settle.

lines.zh: 田那头站着个人，我直起腰。
lines.en: Someone stands past the field; I straighten up.
I nod once.

lines.zh: 我背好手，从田埂这头出发。
lines.en: Hands behind my back, I set off along the ridge.
My steps are steady.
Hands behind my back, I stand on the ridge.
I glance your way.

lines.zh: 火把我的衣服燎了一块。
lines.en: Fire scorched a patch of my clothes.

lines.zh: 我从坡上摔下来，摔得发懵。
lines.en: I fell from the slope and I'm dazed.

lines.zh: 水灌进栗子壳里，我蹬着上浮。
lines.en: Water fills my chestnut shell; I kick upward.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀得坐到地上。
lines.en: The blast knocks me onto the ground.

lines.zh: 有根箭擦着我的肩过去。
lines.en: An arrow grazed past my shoulder.

lines.zh: 光压下来，我的栗子帽歪了。
lines.en: The light bears down and my chestnut cap tilts.
I'm too hungry to raise a hand.
At the thunder I flinch.
The ridge gives way and I drop.
